All the designations given are to be considered in a given order (as Chairman is considered as Senior- most and Clerk is considered as the Junior-most). Only two persons are senior to B. One designation lies between B and G. The number of persons junior to G is same as the number of persons senior to C. H is just senior to E, but junior to C. More than four designations lie between H and F. D is junior to A.
